rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an election as a voting event or process.

example.english: I’m definitely going to vote in this election.
example.traditional: 今次選舉我一定去投票。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ngo5 jat1 ding6 heoi3 tau4 piu3

rows.note: Use this noun phrase for the fact that A was elected, rather than for the election event itself.
